MOLOBOCO orc, SB Secretary Cawayan, Masbate Dear Sir: 2m o This pertains to your letter seeking our legal opinion regarding the legal effect of filing a certificate of candidacy as Sangguniang Bayan Member of the President of the Association of Barangay Captains of Cawayan, Masbate. In reply thereto, please be informed that we had already an occasion to answer a similar query in DILG Opinion No. 5 series of 2010, dated 15 January 2010. In the said opinion, we opined that the ABC President is not considered resigned upon filing of his certificate of candidacy for the same or any other elective office or position (Sec. 4, COMELEC Resolution No. 8678, promulgated on 6 October 2009). *Attached herewith is a photocopy of DILG Opinion No. 5 series of 2010 for your ready perusal. We hope this settles your concern. Very truly yours, By Authority of the Secretary ATTY. JESUS B. bo UE, Director III Cs/12/rb#26
